caption: The drawing consists of two depictions of the same object: a candle holder. On the left side, there are two technical line drawings, one showing a side elevation view and the other showing a top-down view; these are both outlined in black and contain no color. The side view displays the straight cylindrical stem of the holder with markings for structural details and a round knob on the side, while the top-down view illustrates the round, shallow base with a hexagonal shape inscribed within it. Attached to the base's rim is a semi-oval handle. To the right of these technical views is a colored rendering of the candle holder shown in three-quarter perspective. This depiction is shaded in tones of gold and brown, indicating a metallic, likely brass, material. The main structure includes a wide, slightly concave circular base, a central cylinder with ridged decoration near the top, and a protruding knob and ring handle on the side. The drawing is surrounded by a thin rectangular border, and the lower right corner contains a handwritten signature, "J. Staloff." The background is a light beige color, and the paper shows signs of minor brown spotting, especially near the edges.
title: Candlestick
